description: One object as the storage service's list route answers it, captured from a real response (caller-rules.test.ts). The contract for every storage server: the Node service checks its answers against this file, @supatype/client builds its fixture from it, and supatype-server's local objstore keeps a byte-identical copy at internal/objstore/testdata/node-list-entry.json. `nullable` names the fields that may be null instead of the kind shown.
